name: Canny
desc: Product feedback management platform. Collect, organize, and prioritize feature requests from your users.

actions.name: create_post
actions.description: Creates a new post on a Canny board.

actions.name: retrieve_post
actions.description: Retrieves the details of an existing post by its ID.

actions.name: list_posts
actions.description: Returns a list of posts for a board, with optional filtering and sorting.

actions.name: create_vote
actions.description: Casts a vote on a post on behalf of a user.

actions.name: delete_vote
actions.description: Removes a vote from a post for a given user.

triggers.name: new_post
triggers.description: Triggers when a new post is created on a Canny board.

triggers.name: post_status_changed
triggers.description: Triggers when a post's status is changed (e.g. open → in progress → complete).

triggers.name: new_comment
triggers.description: Triggers when a new comment is created on a post.

triggers.name: new_vote
triggers.description: Triggers when a user votes on a post.
